description: Geometric test of the SDD3 zinc site in the AlphaFold model: His60/His64 spacing and identification of the third zinc ligand
code:
import numpy as np, itertools, requests, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

pdb=open("/agent/jobs/2fb7d3bc-c93f-41e8-8a0e-1b6aa78e6a58/provenance/af_Q12496.pdb").read()
atoms={}
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
        res=int(ln[22:26]); an=ln[12:16].strip(); aa=ln[17:20].strip()
        atoms.setdefault(res,{"aa":aa,"at":{}})["at"][an]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])

def sc(res, names):
    d=atoms[res]["at"]; return {n:d[n] for n in names if n in d}

print("Residue identities:", {p:atoms[p]["aa"] for p in [60,63,64,130,135,142,153,155,158]})

# zinc-coordinating atoms: His NE2/ND1 ; Glu OE1/OE2
H60=sc(60,["NE2","ND1"]); H64=sc(64,["NE2","ND1"]); E63=sc(63,["OE1","OE2"])
cands={p:sc(p,["OE1","OE2"]) for p in [130,135,142,153,155,158] if atoms[p]["aa"]=="GLU"}

def mind(a,b): return min(np.linalg.norm(x-y) for x in a.values() for y in b.values())

print(f"\nHis60 - His64 min side-chain N..N distance: {mind(H60,H64):.2f} A   (zinc site His-His typically 3.0-4.5 A)")
print(f"His60 - Glu63 : {mind(H60,E63):.2f} A ;  His64 - Glu63 : {mind(H64,E63):.2f} A")
print("\nCandidate third zinc ligand (Glu) distances to the HxxEH histidines:")
rows=[]
for p,c in sorted(cands.items()):
    d1,d2=mind(H60,c),mind(H64,c)
    rows.append((p,d1,d2,min(d1,d2)))
    print(f"  Glu{p:4d}:  to His60 {d1:6.2f} A   to His64 {d2:6.2f} A")

# Model zinc position = point minimising distance to His60-NE2, His64-NE2, best Glu
from scipy.optimize import minimize
def fit(ligatoms):
    pts=np.array(ligatoms)
    f=lambda x: np.sum((np.linalg.norm(pts-x,axis=1)-2.05)**2)
    r=minimize(f, pts.mean(0)); return r.x, np.linalg.norm(pts-r.x,axis=1)

best=None
for p,c in sorted(cands.items()):
    lig=[H60.get("NE2",H60.get("ND1")), H64.get("NE2",H64.get("ND1"))]
    for oname,ov in c.items():
        zn,dd=fit(lig+[ov])
        rmsd=np.sqrt(np.mean((dd-2.05)**2))
        if best is None or rmsd<best[0]: best=(rmsd,p,oname,zn,dd)
        print(f"  trial His60/His64/Glu{p}-{oname}: fitted Zn ligand distances {np.round(dd,2)} (target 2.05 A), rmsd {rmsd:.2f}")
print(f"\nBEST tetrahedral-ish fit: Glu{best[1]} ({best[2]}), rmsd {best[0]:.2f} A")
zn=best[3]
print("Catalytic Glu63 carboxylate to fitted Zn:", round(min(np.linalg.norm(v-zn) for v in E63.values()),2), "A (expected ~4 A, water-bridged)")

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4.2))
ps=[r[0] for r in rows]; d60=[r[1] for r in rows]; d64=[r[2] for r in rows]
x=np.arange(len(ps)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,d60,w,label="to His60 (Zn ligand 1)",color="#4C72B0")
ax.bar(x+w/2,d64,w,label="to His64 (Zn ligand 2)",color="#DD8452")
ax.axhspan(0,6,color="green",alpha=0.10)
ax.axhline(6,ls="--",c="green",lw=1)
ax.text(len(ps)-0.4,6.3,"6 A: plausible shared Zn site",color="green",ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"Glu{p}" for p in ps])
ax.set_ylabel("Minimum side-chain distance (A)")
ax.set_title("SDD3 (Q12496) AlphaFold model: which Glu joins the His60/His64 zinc site")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
